purpose: Phase-two, model-targeted prompts. Kept SEPARATE from manifest.json because that file's sha256 is pinned as an asset inside experiments/retention-e5.plan.json and retention-e7.plan.json, both of which describe executed experiments: adding an entry there would make two committed plans describe something other than what was run. The phase-one library stays frozen; new prompts are catalogued here.

prompts.changes: Three constraints added to UNSCORED free-text fields only: `recommendation`, `call_event_detection`, and the quoted phrase behind `keyword`. No rule, class definition, vocabulary, threshold or worked-example label differs from the parent.
prompts.change_policy: The edit list in prompts.py is the change history; it must remain an exact transformation of the parent. Any further text or decoding change creates a new prompt id.

prompts.changes: v9_16_q1 with `recommendation` made a deterministic function of `call_event_detection` rather than constrained free text. Iteration 1 obeyed its length constraint (217 -> 61 chars mean) and moved raw instability by zero.

prompts.caveat: Canned advice is a product decision for the app owners, not a harness one. This id exists to make an experiment interpretable, not as a deployment proposal.
